judgments.yea_description: Voted for House Bill 1217, which would have barred South Dakota schools, colleges and universities from using public money to support unions. They could no longer deduct union dues from pay, share more worker data than the law requires, or pay workers for union activity unless the union repaid the cost. Breaking the rule would have brought civil penalties and lawsuits. The South Dakota House rejected it, 27-40. The bill did not become law.
